items.title: Sony: GTA VI is the biggest launch in PlayStation history, with 39 million PS5 players
items.summary: Sony says GTA VI is the biggest game launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations: more than 39 million unique players on PS5 between November 19 and 22, a new PlayStation record for concurrent players, 683 million hours played at 17.4 hours per player on average, and the most newly connected PS5 consoles in a single day since the system's 2020 launch outside the holidays, with GTA VI the first game played on 70% of those new consoles.

items.title: Guide: open the portal to the PS2-era Malibu Club and earn Tommy Vercetti's shirt
items.summary: Kotaku explains how to unlock the hidden trip back to 2002 that YouTuber Memeio first cracked: start at the tower in Key Lento, then work the switches at 12 LPL substations in the order of the old Vice City cheat 'Life Is Passing Me By' without fast travelling, follow the text message to Reactor 2 at the power plant between 7 p.m. and 6 a.m., and step through the portal into the PS2-era Malibu Club to find Kent Paul and return with Tommy Vercetti's blue Hawaiian shirt and a chopper motorcycle.

items.title: Rockstar releases GTA VI: The Album (Deluxe Edition) with 23 bonus tracks
items.summary: Rockstar announced the Deluxe Edition of the GTA VI album is out now on major streaming services, adding 23 bonus tracks with contributions from The Dare, Slayyyter, Denzel Curry, HEALTH, Power Trip, Real Dimez x Sexyy Red and more, on top of the original 34-track release.

items.title: Guide: find Port Gellhorn's missing tourists and its serial killer
items.summary: Polygon's guide starts the side mission from the missing-person posters in the Starlet Motel office after Chapter 2, sneaks into the warehouse across from Moses' garage for the photo clues, then tracks the three tourists — a pink car in the central Gelhorn junkyard, a car in the water at Wild Hog Point, and floorboards in a blue trailer at the north-end trailer park — before a return to the warehouse ends the hunt.

items.title: Guide: 'Dealer's Choice' pure vs. cut drugs outcomes explained
items.summary: Polygon explains the Chapter 3 choice for Dre'Quan and Tyrone: selling the pure drugs runs smoothly for $1,500 and a 'professional' profile bump, while the cut drugs anger the buyers — defusing at half price matches the clean outcome, but talking tough forces a shootout and police escape for the same $1,500 and a 'violent' profile bump.

items.title: Guide: find the Silent Hill hotel and open the Marbelle safe
items.summary: Polygon's guide sends you to the Marbelle Hotel in Crosstown, Vice City, beside Pizza Pete: enter by the east door and climb to the top floor to trigger the fog event, then open the desk safe with code 955214 — found on the staircase wall or in roof notes — for $234 and a Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast' watch.

items.title: GTA VI hacker Arion Kurtaj walks free after sentencing
items.summary: Polygon reports the Lapsus$ hacker behind the 2022 Rockstar breach, which leaked 90 clips of unfinished GTA VI and cost the studio about $5 million, was sentenced to seven years at Woolwich Crown Court and released under supervision the same day, Nov. 23, with time already served credited and a five-year order restricting his online activity.

items.title: Guide: find the UFO dream house near Key Lento
items.summary: Polygon's guide continues the UFO storyline after the first Port Gellhorn encounter and the dream that follows: the house sits north of Gambit Bay and south of Hamlet, northeast of the airstrip near Key Lento — cut through Southpoint airfield and hop the fence section without barbed wire to reach the front entrance.

items.title: A San Andreas painting from 2021 hid GTA VI's strangest house
items.summary: Polygon traces a beige house with a UFO over it, first added as a painting in the 2021 San Andreas remaster, to a real home in GTA VI's Belville whose garage holds a conspiracy board insisting 'IT'S A SIMULATION,' riffing on identical NPCs, invisible borders around Leonida and Jason and Lucia as the only ones with free will.

items.title: Rockstar publishes patch notes for GTA VI update 1.002.002
items.summary: Rockstar's official notes for the November 23 update list seven fixes, covering crashes, weather that stayed static for long stretches, autosaving that did not work correctly, story-progressing phone calls that failed to trigger, players being unable to lose their Wanted Level, a broken gym deadlift bar, and partners not handing over bags meant for fences.

items.title: Report: GTA VI hits 44.9 million copies through its first weekend
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million copies through its first weekend, split 33.7 million on PS5 and 11.2 million on Xbox Series X|S, lifting estimated sales to about $4 billion in four days, with around 40.8 million people playing on Sunday, November 22 alone and roughly 9 million already past 20 hours played.

items.title: GTA VI's first post-launch patch is rolling out in waves
items.summary: Update 1.002.002 began rolling out on November 23 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in three staggered waves over about six hours, at roughly 604 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox, according to reports citing PlayStation Game Size; Rockstar has not yet published official patch notes, so what the patch changes is still unknown.

items.title: Guide: start the Hell event and beat its demon boss
items.summary: Polygon's guide shows how to trigger the Hell event by meeting Dave and Beelzebub at their garage on the north side of Port Hellhorn after starting Chapter 2 and visiting after 10 p.m., riding the van to a campfire ritual that sends you to Hell, then making the final boss vulnerable by destroying its exploding headless demons to earn the Hellspawn Comshot, a Circles of Hell top and tattoo, and a permanent max health upgrade.

items.title: Guide: find the Fast & Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse on Vespucci Island
items.summary: Polygon's guide shows where to steal Brian O'Conner's green Eclipse, in-game as the '97 Maibatsu Penumbra FF, from a gated house on Vespucci Island in Vice-Dale County: break in beside the garage before the alarm, use the slim jim if you've met Moses, then pay $6,750 to register the fast coupe or sell it for $1,100.

items.title: Players find a tow-truck trick to rip ATMs out of walls for cash
items.summary: Polygon reports players are discovering new ways to get rich, including a Reddit find that a tow truck's hook can yank an outdoor ATM clean out of a building wall, drag it to a safe spot and smash it open for the cash inside, alongside opportunistic loot from crashed robbery scenes.
